title: Stress git-vouch-migrate with other projects' keyrings
description: Mark 2026-10-22 (revised plan): other projects' keyrings are a source of test cases, not migration targets (port is pgpkeys-only, DESIGN.md). Stage all five corpora (GNU, Arch, Apache, FreeBSD, Gentoo) into one local union repo, never committed; run port once; collect distinct failure types; turn each into a small real-gpg fixture in tests/migrate; discard the corpora. Priority by kernel value: GNU high (import failures, v3/old algorithms), FreeBSD medium, Gentoo/Arch/Apache low. Key question: does one unimportable key abort the whole port (gpg import is all-or-nothing)? Skip-and-report vs fail-closed is Mark's call.
close_reason: Failure types fixed and covered by fixtures
